source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB Platform Event injection; SEL readback and event routing are separate dependent evidence.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x04/0x02 with seven bytes copied/mapped from SEL entry; clear logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; operator event bytes; warns SEL generation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes mutation but does not validate sensor/event semantics or PEF side effects.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires one harmless allowlisted event, sandboxed PEF/receiver, SEL correlation and recovery.
historical_reviews.history: Related Add SEL is not equivalent because Platform Event can route and trigger PEF.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No arbitrary event injection or log clearing is authorized.

original_test_intent: Inject one valid platform event and verify its exact SEL/routing treatment without causing unapproved PEF actions.
original_method: Send Sensor/Event 0x04/0x02 with EvMRev, sensor type/number, direction/type and three event-data bytes.
manual_activity: Owner approves one harmless event vector, PEF/receiver isolation, expected SEL record and recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Placeholder avoids guessing but lacks semantic allowlist and PEF/SEL safety gates.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected 0x04/0x02 with one approved seven-byte vector only after PEF and receiver actions are sandboxed.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Seven source fields and timing preserved; no Script exists.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline SEL/routing, inject one supported benign event, match exact record and assert no unapproved action.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds semantic vector validation and side-effect controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Completion alone does not prove SEL content, delivery or absence of PEF action.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A valid event may trigger power or external alerts depending on configuration.

project_override_considerations: A vendor event-injection API is equivalent only with the same event semantics, SEL/routing evidence and PEF safety boundary.
expected_evidence: Approved event vector and sensor map

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and seven-byte Platform Event layout align; missing concrete vector is a readiness gap.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operation is defined; safe vector and sandbox require Project approval.

review_improvement: Prevents arbitrary copied bytes from triggering real PEF actions and makes the SEL/event oracle deterministic.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same seven-byte message can be logged, forwarded and matched by a PEF rule; therefore acceptance must correlate all three paths. Copying bytes from an existing SEL entry does not prove the target sensor accepts them safely, and completion without the exact new record is inadequate.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code, Platform Event, SEL and PEF search
